objective: Computation. Splice knot spaces with one and two Fano atoms in plane glue (both splice orders) into K4^(3), census 6, the Fano plane and census 58; at every removal with six port patterns, find the new crossing knots exactly up to three points (join lemma, closure up to the size bound) and map them by the gluing line's piece and the removal's piece. Test whether creation happens exactly at gluing lines on handles, and whether pinnings from a handle reach gluing lines in a plane piece.
status: Proved by HANDLE-LOCALITY-20261103-001B-P001 (screening lemma; exhaustive computation): when a cut carries one bit, creation at a plane gluing line is creation on a plane knot space minus a line. On six composite near sides and four far sides, no new knot appears when neither the gluing line nor the removal lies on a handle (896 cases), nor beside a handle attached at a line (224); a handle attached at a point, opened by the removal, creates at plane gluing lines up to distance 5. There, 1,092 of 2,496 new knots are unpinned, and four-point new knots appear inside handles, so the pinned three-point premise fails on composite spaces
title: Where creation happens
